problem: Grow the economy and attract entrepreneurs beyond Estonia's borders.
title: Estonia launches e-Residency for non-residents
context: Estonia had a highly digital public sector and a small domestic market.
decision_made: Offer a government-issued digital identity that lets non-residents set up and run a company online.
observed_outcome: The programme reports more than 135,000 to 142,000 e-residents, over 39,000 companies founded, and a total economic impact of about 124.9 million euros in 2025 against about 10 million euros of public spending.
lessons: A digital service can become an export, though the impact figure depends on the model used.
limitations: Figures come mainly from the programme itself, which has an incentive to present them favourably. Cumulative contribution figures differ (about 400 million versus 433 million euros).

claims.claim_text: The programme reports about 124.9 million euros of economic impact in 2025 against about 10 million euros of public expenditure.
